verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's VC practice pages document deep involvement in the venture capital lifecycle (deal volume, full spectrum of equity investments, TwoVenture startup hub, term sheet automation, employee incentive plans like EMI/growth shares), which supports startup-formation-adjacent work, but there is no explicit mention of incorporation services (charter, bylaws, initial board consents, founder stock purchase) as a documented offering. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of company incorporation/formation deliverables (articles/charter, bylaws, board consents, founder stock purchase agreements), and any case study or client testimonial confirming this specific service.
